title: 第281章 海瑟薇的湮灭巨舰第280章 维多利亚到来
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
“不错！”维多利亚的的语气带上了一丝敬意。
它的全名叫做“海瑟薇的湮灭巨舰！”
“是一个巨大的战争平台，数万米长，像一座移动的要塞。
核心功能是亚空间航行——可以搭载大量人员和物资在星海中远距离移动。
速度远超任何浮空船，也远超你见过的那些机械世界造物。
并且它还拥有不俗的破坏力，搭载的主炮可以打出堪比半神攻击的威力！！”
罗恩越听嘴巴张的越大。
这还是中世纪吗？
我那边还在用鞭子抽农奴呢。
你这里都开上星舰了！
你们玩魔法的都这么豪横吗？
罗恩在考虑自己是不是也该打造一支魔法师军团了。
他之前的小学院根本不顶用。
不过维多利亚没理会罗恩的震惊，继续往下说：
“这个项目的负责人就是海瑟薇，她是一位天才的三级炼金师，也是从我们魔法帝国走出来的。
最后来到学城定居，她在这组建了一支庞大的研究团队。
数十座重工实验室和炼金工厂，专门研究机械造物和魔能科技的结合。
湮灭巨舰就是她们最重要、也是最庞大的项目。”
这个项目已经持续了上百年了，本来早就可以落地。
但随着一项项技术出世，如亚空间穿梭稳定、主炮魔能传导回路等等，就不断的更新迭代。

所需的物资、技术也越来越多。
好在她这项研究受到了学城和魔法帝国的重视。
两方都愿意对这个项目提供大量支持。
所以最后这也变成了一个三方合作的项目。
最近几年，随着机械世界的征服，团队也是从中得到了不少技术灵感。
连风暴龙神的残骸都交给了她们研究。
最后仿造风暴龙神的龙皇异次元，升级了一下巨舰的主炮。
这才达到了半神级的打击标准。
其他的诸如推进装置、能量块制作技术等等也吸取了不少。
这才让这个项目加速落地。”
罗恩已经被震惊到无话可说了，问道：
“现在已经造出来了吗？”
维多利亚点点头，伸出两根手指：
“目前实物造出来的有两艘，一艘是实验室组成的实验品。”
“另一艘是打造出来的标准品，以后都按照这种型号制造。”
目前船坞已经扩建完成了，第一批批量生产已经开始了。
但这第一批的湮灭巨舰，自然是被魔法帝国包圆了。
这次泰伦会议期间拿出来分配的福利。
则是第二批湮灭巨舰的名额。
看到维多利亚对湮灭巨舰这么推崇，罗恩也是问了一句：
content_en:
"Not bad!" Victoria's tone brought a hint of respect.
Its full name is "Hathaway's Annihilation Ship!"
“It is a huge war platform, tens of thousands of meters long, like a mobile fortress.
The core function is subspace navigation - it can carry a large number of people and materials to move long distances in the star sea.
The speed is far faster than any floating ship, and also far faster than those creations of the mechanical world you have seen.
And it also has considerable destructive power, and its main gun can fire attacks as powerful as a demigod! ! "
The more Ron listened, the wider his mouth opened.
Is this still the Middle Ages?
I'm still whipping the serfs over there.
You have a starship here!
Are all of you magicians so arrogant?
Ron was thinking about whether he should also build an army of magicians.
His previous small college was of no use at all.
However, Victoria ignored Ron's shock and continued:
"The person in charge of this project is Hathaway. She is a talented third-level alchemist who also came from our Magic Empire.
Finally, she settled in the school city, where she formed a large research team.
Dozens of heavy industry laboratories and alchemy factories specialize in researching the combination of mechanical creation and magic technology.
The Annihilation Ship is their most important and largest project. "
This project has been going on for hundreds of years and could have been implemented long ago.
But as each technology comes out, such as subspace shuttle stability, main gun magic energy transmission circuit, etc., it is constantly updated and iterated.
More and more materials and technologies are required.
Fortunately, her research was taken seriously by the city and the Magic Empire.
Both parties are willing to provide substantial support for the project.
So in the end this became a three-party cooperation project.
In recent years, with the conquest of the mechanical world, the team has also obtained a lot of technical inspiration from it.
Even the remains of the Storm Dragon God were given to them for study.
Finally, the Dragon Emperor's different dimension imitated the Storm Dragon God and upgraded the main gun of the giant ship.
Only then did it reach the semi-god-level strike standard.
Other things such as propulsion devices, energy block production technology, etc. have also been absorbed a lot.
This accelerated the implementation of this project. "
Ron was so shocked that he was speechless and asked:
"Has it been created now? "
Victoria nodded and held out two fingers:
“Currently, there are two actual ships built, and one is an experimental product composed of a laboratory. "
“The other ship is a standard product, and it will be built according to this model in the future. "
At present, the shipyard expansion has been completed and the first batch of mass production has begun.
But the first batch of annihilation giant ships were naturally surrounded by the Magic Empire.
The benefits were distributed during this Tyrann meeting.
It is the quota for the second batch of annihilation giant ships.
